reasoning_content:
The home page returns HTTP 200. Vite dev server had an esbuild error related to NavUser.vue (which isn't part of the MainPage). But the actual page entry may still work. Let me verify the page actually renders — the MainPage imports Navigation, Sensor, Ochsi, HomeInfoCard, SensorCard. Let me check if vite serves those modules. But the esbuild error was during dev server startup dependency scan. Let me check if the page assets load correctly.

Actually, the key question for "installation success" is whether the app runs. The home page returns 200. Let me check whether Vite can serve the MainPage component and its imports. Let me request the app.ts and MainPage modules via Vite.

But first, the missing components issue is a repo defect. The project at this commit has broken references in Dashboard.vue/AppHeader.vue/NavUser.vue, but those aren't used by MainPage at all. Wait — AppSidebar imports NavUser, and AppSidebar is imported by AppSidebarLayout, which is imported by AppLayout. But MainPage doesn't use AppLayout. So MainPage is fully independent.

Let me confirm MainPage's dependencies all resolve. Let me check Navigation.vue imports.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== curl vite main page ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "app.ts HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/app.ts"
curl -s -o /tmp/mp.js -w "MainPage HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:5173/resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue"
echo "=== check imports of MainPage deps ==="
grep -rn "^import\|from '" resources/js/components/Navigation.vue resources/js/components/Sensor.vue resources/js/components/Ochsi.vue resources/js/components/HomeInfoCard.vue resources/js/components/SensorCard.vue | grep -oE "from '[^']+'" | sort -u
